# Emily

- **Role:** schoolteacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Emily is recognized as a pattern housekeeper who keeps things neat and tidy. She also possesses great taste and unequaled skill when it comes to the fit of her dressmaking.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_

## History

A former schoolteacher, Emily separated from her husband, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), after demanding he choose between her and his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), subsequently returning to her own house. Following the parrot's death, she arrived in a wagon looking for her husband and went to his house. Regretting her past haste in their split, she walked [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after reuniting with him.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P25](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0025), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), +2 more_

## Quotes

> "I want to get acquainted with all my new neighbors just as soon as possible. Mrs. Lynde is a lovely woman, isn’t she? So friendly."
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P61](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0061)

> "Well, I did think this place seemed too tidy . . . much too tidy for James A. to be living here, unless he has greatly changed since I knew him"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P12](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0012)

> "A friend sent a marked copy to me . . . friends are always so ready to do such things. James A.‘s name was written in over ‘new citizen.’"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P14](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0014)

> "because he happens to be married already. I am his wife. Oh, you may well look surprised. I suppose he has been masquerading as a bachelor and breaking hearts right and left. Well, well, James A.,"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016)

> "your fun is over. I am here . . . though I wouldn’t have bothered coming if I hadn’t thought you were up to some mischief. I suppose,"
>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016)

## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--rachel-lynde.md)

Emily struck up a lifelong friendship with [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) following her return to her husband. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discussed the Harrisons' situation with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) during Emily's unexpected arrival.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), +2 more_
